name: build-pipeline
body: The build + release pipeline that compiles and stages the eight frontends: `build.rs` (build script driven by `APG_BUILD_FRONTENDS`, used by dev and CI `cargo build`), the CI release workflow that builds the per-language packages and bottles, and the split Homebrew formulae plus `install.sh` that each build one frontend directly. It owns the toolchain pins. The CI workflow and the formulae are config artifacts the code graph does not model, so the plan carries their pin edits; `build.rs` is the graph-visible half of the pipeline.
